sections.h2: Website Challenges Real Estate Businesses Face — and How We Solve Them
sections.intro: Every agent or builder researching Real Estate Website Design Kerala runs into the same four problems.

items.title: Listings live only on third-party portals.
items.text: Relying only on aggregator sites means paying for leads that could come directly from a branded website. Every Real Estate Website Design Kerala build gives every listing its own searchable, shareable page the business actually owns.

items.title: NRI buyers can't evaluate a property from abroad.
items.text: A huge share of Kerala's real estate demand comes from NRIs who can't visit before deciding. Real Estate Website Design for NRI Buyers Kerala work builds in virtual tours, currency context, and clear remote-enquiry paths so distance stops being a barrier.

items.title: Agents have no individual online presence.
items.text: Buyers want to know who they're dealing with, but many sites list properties with no visible agent identity. Real Estate Website Design Kerala from Teknoppy gives each agent credentials, listings, and direct contact.

items.title: Enquiries get lost between a contact form and a follow-up call.
items.text: A generic contact page loses the urgency a serious buyer has. Every Real Estate Website Design Kerala build routes enquiries by property and by agent.

Frequently Asked Questions — Real Estate Website Design Kerala

items.q: How long does Real Estate Website Design Kerala take?
items.a: A standard site with listings, agent profiles, and enquiry forms typically takes three to five weeks. A larger builder or developer site with multiple project pages can take five to eight weeks.

items.q: How much does an Affordable Real Estate Website Design Kerala build cost?
items.a: Cost depends on listing volume and whether virtual tours or a payment gateway are included — a basic agent site costs far less than a multi-project build.

items.q: Can the website target NRI buyers specifically?
items.a: Yes — Real Estate Website Design for NRI Buyers Kerala is one of the most requested features, built around virtual tours, clear remote-enquiry paths, and content that answers questions a buyer abroad actually has.

items.q: Will each agent get their own profile and listings?
items.a: Yes — Real Estate Agent Website Design Kerala pages give every agent credentials, contact details, and their own active listings, not a shared team page.

items.q: Can builders showcase multiple ongoing projects on one site?
items.a: Yes — Builder and Developer Website Design Kerala sites are structured with one page per project, each with its own floor plans, unit types, and construction status.

items.q: Is Google Maps integration included on every listing?
items.a: Yes — Real Estate Website Google Maps Integration Kerala is treated as a core feature, not an optional extra, on every property page.
